WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
per_category_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count
    FROM category_stats
),
qualifying_categories AS (
    SELECT cs.avg_relative_overspend, cs.line_count, p.avg_line_count
    FROM category_stats AS cs
    CROSS JOIN per_category_average AS p
    WHERE cs.line_count > p.avg_line_count
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend,
    AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count,
    AVG(1.0 * line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count
FROM qualifying_categories;

assumptions.assumption: A zero amount makes relative overspend undefined, so those rows are excluded from its average; NULL spent or amount values are also ignored by AVG. Rows with spent = 0 and nonzero amount are included, yielding -1.
The per-category average line count is computed across all categories, including any NULL category group, if present.
